description: the same bored frustum (the cone r = 3 − z/2 about z, bore r = 1, z ∈ [−2, 2]) with a slot `2w` wide cut past it from y = b outwards, through both caps: the slot's floor y = b and its two walls x = ±w are all parallel to the cone's axis, so each meets the cone in an exact hyperbola (ADR-0018) and carries it as a section edge with a Curve2 on the plane and a fitted pcurve on the cone. b > 1 keeps the slot clear of the bore and the apex is outside the operand, so the result is genus 1 — a groove, not a handle. Its volume has no closed form over the recipe grammar (the chord of a circle wants asin), so the oracle holds it
